gaps.explanation: Two parts. (1) Missing fund column: the Street column on p3 prints Transfers in 26,200 and Transfers out (400); neither is in detail, so both are added here (transfers out has no gap row because the statement Total column prints no transfers out). (2) Different basis: the statement Total Governmental Funds column nets through its Reclassifications column: Street 26,200 - 9,325 = 16,875. The schedule total 35,554 counts every positive other-financing detail line from the p8 General Fund departmental schedule: department transfers in General 9,425 + Social Security 7,552 + Unemployment 800 = 17,777, plus the p8 Reclassifications column's Transfers out entry +17,777 (printed 17,777 on the Transfers out row, cancelling the department transfers; its Transfers in entry (17,777) is recorded as -17,777). Those reclassification lines are printed and net to zero, and the General Fund other-financing lines net to the printed General column (8,925), so nothing is removed. After the additions the positive transfer lines are 35,554 + 26,200 = 61,754 vs statement 16,875; the remaining 44,879 = 17,777 department transfers in + 17,777 reclassification entry + 9,325 Total-column reclassification is gross-vs-netted presentation, not an error.
